title: Frequently asked questions
description: Quick answers for the people of a project

questions.question: How do I join a project?
questions.answer: With the invitation you receive by email, from an admin or from someone in your family. Without an account you choose a password; with one, you sign in and accept. Pending invitations also appear in Your projects. You can also find one under Find a project, if its admins list it.

questions.question: Who sees my family's ranking?
questions.answer: Only your family. Other families never see it, before or after the lottery.

questions.question: Do I have to rank every unit?
questions.answer: No. Move the ones you care about; the rest keep a place of their own at the end of your ranking.

questions.question: Can two of us change the ranking?
questions.answer: Yes: it is one ranking for the whole family, and any member can change it until the lottery runs. The latest change is the one that counts.

questions.question: How does the lottery decide?
questions.answer: It first makes the family that would be worst off as well off as possible, then the whole project as satisfied as possible. Only ties are broken at random.

questions.question: Can the result change?
questions.answer: It is final. Only in exceptional cases an admin may invalidate a run; everyone then sees who did it, when and why, and the lottery runs again.

questions.question: Who sees the files I share?
questions.answer: Everyone in the project, and nobody outside it. You can edit the description or remove what you shared.

questions.question: I changed my email and nothing happened.
questions.answer: We sent a confirmation link to the new address. Your account keeps the old one until you open it.
